name: comp-583

frames.best_why: The project dropdown is open with both names and a tick on the current one.

tagline: Breadcrumb header that shows your account path and switches project in place.
summary: A slim dark header with a breadcrumb trail from logo through Personal Account and Projects to a project switcher button, plus a notification bell and user avatar.
appearance: A slim dark header holds a breadcrumb: starburst logo, slash, Personal Account, slash, Projects, slash, then a ghost button with the current project name and an up-down chevron. A bell with a dot and a round avatar sit at the far right.
behaviour: Hovering a breadcrumb link underlines it. The project button opens a small dropdown naming the projects with a tick on the current one; choosing another swaps the label and closes the list.
demo_content: Breadcrumb reads Personal Account / Projects / Main project; the menu offers Main project and Origin project.
search_phrases: app top bar with trail of links
use_when: A workspace app needs to show where you are and let you switch project from the top bar.
avoid_when: Only two projects are listed and the trail is fixed to account and projects, so deeper paths need new markup.
customise: The breadcrumb trail and the two project names are written in the file; the notification and user menus come from separate pieces.
weight_why: A breadcrumb, one select and two small buttons.

a11y.note: The project select and breadcrumb are labelled, but the logo link has no accessible name.

polish_why: Neat breadcrumb with a working project switcher; targets are small and the bar very slim.
